source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

secondary_sources.source: Kew POWO; Flora of Tropical East Africa cited under Cinnamomum camphora

morphology.habit: Much-branched tree 6–12 m (Flora of Tropical East Africa description)
morphology.leaves: Alternate ovate to ovate-elliptic, 5–11 × 2–6 cm; acuminate tip, cuneate base; glands in axils of principal nerves
morphology.flowers: Small yellow or white flowers in panicles

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: No named treatment in 1999 regional flora; generic Lauraceae comments mention Cinnamomum camphor but are not a species treatment
Kew POWO accepts Camphora officinarum; Cinnamomum camphora is its synonym
Kew gives indigenous range in parts of eastern Asia, so not local Texas-native plant
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
